name: CONSUMPTION_OVERVIEW_SWR_20261108
comment: 3.8-4.3 s normally and 16.9 s at load average 27, with no cache: every GET recomputed the body,
and the cold compute re-parsed the 114 MB provider_cost/events.jsonl in anthropic_monitoring._events
(617-1262 ms of CPU per miss; the file is appended continuously, so its whole-file fingerprint cache
almost never hit). The route now joins stale_serve.DEFAULT_SWR_PATHS (last good body served at once,
one background refresh, 5 minute staleness cap) and request_coalesce.DEFAULT_COALESCE_PATHS.
This gate pins what makes that safe: a warm hit never recomputes, a stale body is served with its age
and starts exactly one refresh, an error is never cached (the page keeps the real failure), a body
older than the cap is recomputed inline, and the operator's own consumption writes drop the body.
Registered because a new pytest file that no gate names is not run by CI (check_test_coverage --fail-on-new).
